The database schema named 'rschema_0078' contains four tables: 'Author', 'Article', 'Author_creates_article', and 'Author_modifies_article'.
The 'Author' table represents the authors of the articles. It has an integer primary key 'Author_ID', and several other columns including 'Email', 'Gender', 'Introduction', 'Name', and 'Phone' which are all of type VARCHAR(255).
The 'Article' table represents the articles. It has an integer primary key 'Article_ID', and several other columns including 'Article_collection_volume', 'Article_comment_volume', 'Article_content', 'Article_like_volume', 'Article_reading_volume', 'Article_title', 'Creation_time', 'Last_modification_and_save_author_ID', 'Last_modification_and_save_time', and 'Total_number_of_words_in_the_article' which are all of type INTEGER. The 'Last_modification_and_save_author_ID' column does not allow null values and is a foreign key referencing the 'Author_ID' in the 'Author' table.
The 'Author_creates_article' table represents the relationship between authors and articles. It has two integer columns 'Article_ID' and 'Author_ID' which are both not null and are primary keys. It also has 'Author_order', 'Author_responsible_for_part', and 'Author_role' which are all of type VARCHAR(255). The 'Article_ID' and 'Author_ID' columns are foreign keys referencing the 'Article_ID' and 'Author_ID' in the 'Article' and 'Author' tables respectively.
The 'Author_modifies_article' table represents the modifications made by authors on articles. It has three integer columns 'Article_ID', 'Author_ID', and 'Modify_save_time' which are not null and are the primary keys. It also has 'Modify_notes', and 'Modify_start_time' which are of type VARCHAR(255) and DATETIME respectively. The 'Article_ID' and 'Author_ID' columns are foreign keys referencing the 'Article_ID' and 'Author_ID' in the 'Article' and 'Author' tables respectively. The 'Modify_save_time' column is a foreign key referencing the 'Modify_save_time' in the 'Author_creates_article' table.
gold_question: The article management system manages multiple articles. Each article has an article ID, article title, article content, creation time, total number of words, article reading volume, article like volume, article collection volume, article comment volume, the time of the last modification and save, and the author ID of the last modification and save. The system also manages multiple authors. Each author has an author ID, name, gender, phone number, email address, and introduction. Each article can be created by multiple authors, and the author order, responsible part, and role of each author are recorded. Authors can modify articles, and each modification records the modification start time, modification save time, and modification notes. The system ensures the accuracy of article content and the transparency of author contributions by recording article creation and modification information.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0078
CREATE TABLE `Author` (
  `Author_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Gender` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Introduction` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Phone` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Author_ID`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Article` (
  `Article_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Article_collection_volume` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Article_comment_volume` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Article_content` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Article_like_volume` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Article_reading_volume` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Article_title` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Creation_time` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Last_modification_and_save_author_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Last_modification_and_save_time` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Total_number_of_words_in_the_article` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Article_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `article_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Last_modification_and_save_author_ID`) REFERENCES `Author` (`Author_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Author_creates_article` (
  `Article_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Author_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Author_order` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Author_responsible_for_part` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Author_role` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Article_ID`, `Author_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `author_creates_article_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Article_ID`) REFERENCES `Article` (`Article_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `author_creates_article_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`Author_ID`) REFERENCES `Author` (`Author_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Author_modifies_article` (
  `Article_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Author_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Modify_save_time` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Modify_notes` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Modify_start_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Article_ID`, `Author_ID`, `Modify_save_time`),
  CONSTRAINT `author_modifies_article_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Article_ID`) REFERENCES `Article` (`Article_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `author_modifies_article_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`Author_ID`) REFERENCES `Author` (`Author_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `author_modifies_article_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`Modify_save_time`) REFERENCES `Author_creates_article` (`Author_order`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
